# Preface {.unnumbered}

## About This Book

This book is designed as an introductory text for a first-year law school course in federal civil procedure. These materials are free to use and may be adapted with permission. 

::: {.callout-note}
Clicking the PDF icon in the sidebar will open this book as a PDF file. Clicking the toggle icon will switch between dark and light mode.
:::
